subject: Request: Exec approval for Dedicated commit & discount (NovaHealth)
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Dedicated capacity estimate and pricing question

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers on your Dedicated offering. We have a proof of concept starting in Q2 and are evaluating committed GPU pool options for production. A few immediate questions from my side:

- For a committed pool equivalent to 12 A100 GPUs (we're modelling peak concurrency), what throughput SLA and 95th pct latency can you guarantee for our typical 32-token responses?
- What are the price tiers for monthly reserved commits (6/12/24 months)?
- Is there an option for an introductory discount or credit for strategic pilots?

Our procurement lead (procurement@novahealth.com) will also want a term sheet. Can you send a ballpark so we can model TCO vs the vendor we’re currently evaluating?

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Head of AI Platform
NovaHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Morales <lena@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity estimate and pricing question

Lena — great to hear, and happy the demo landed well. Short answers up front, then attachments below:

- Throughput/latency: For a 12-A100 reserved pool we expect ~550-700 concurrent streaming requests (depends on request mix); 95th pct latency ~250-300ms for 32-token responses under continuous batching. We can include a throughput guarantee in SLA (we usually offer a throughput SLO tied to commit size).
- Pricing tiers (ballpark): 6mo: $90k/mo, 12mo: $82k/mo, 24mo: $75k/mo (these are reserve-only numbers; usage overage billed at published rates).
- Intro discount/credit: We can do a pilot credit up to 10% of the first 3 months or consider a one-time onboarding credit for strategic accounts — needs manager approval for larger exceptions.

I've attached a Draft MAP (mutual action plan) and a sample term sheet with commit math. The term sheet includes a mid-tier discount band at 15% that requires Sales Leadership approval if we go below it.

Attachment: Draft-MAP-v1.pdf (summary + commit scenarios)

If you want, we can run a short performance validation on our dedicated cluster with a small test harness to firm up the latency numbers.

Next steps: If you can share the procurement contact and the target term length (6/12/24), I'll loop in pricing ops.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Morales <lena@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cesare Rinaldi <cesare.r@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-03-02T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity estimate and pricing question

Thanks Ben. We reviewed the draft MAP and compared it to quotes from Meridian AI (they're offering a 20% discount on a 12mo commit and a 99.9% uptime SLA with explicit throughput guarantees). Two things are blocking for procurement:

1) Price match: procurement is asking whether Redwood can match or get within ~5% of Meridian's economics for the 12mo scenario.
2) Exec exception: since your mid-tier discount floor is 15%, they'd need an exec-level exception to reach ~20% or provide equivalent onboarding credits to bridge the gap.

Also, could you confirm a clearly worded clause for throughput guarantees (what we can expect and remedies)?

Procurement is willing to move quickly if the commercials align — target signature by the end of March.

Lena
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T16:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: NovaHealth — request for price match / exec exception

Team — forwarding NovaHealth's ask. Key points: 12mo commit, asking for ~20% total concession, competitor Meridian quoted 20% and an SLA with throughput guarantees. They want either a price match or onboarding credits to be equivalent. Procurement is ready to sign by EOM if we can bridge.

Options I see:
- Approve a one-time onboarding credit equal to ~5% of TCV + standard 15% discount (keeps list price intact, preserves discount banding).
- Approve reducing price to ~20% for this strategic account (would require an exception to the published discount threshold).
- Offer a hybrid: 17% discount + $50k onboarding credit + a throughput SLO addendum.

I've attached the MAP and the procurement term sheet (nova-procurement-term-sheet.xlsx). If you approve, I will draft the exception request to Legal for redlines and prepare a DocuSign.

Ben

On Mar 2, 2026, at 10:05 AM, Lena Morales <lena@novahealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben. We reviewed the draft MAP and compared it to quotes from Meridian AI (they're offering a 20% discount on a 12mo commit and a 99.9% uptime SLA with explicit throughput guarantees)...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaHealth — request for price match / exec exception

Ben / Marissa — reviewed. NovaHealth is a strategic target in healthcare; keeping momentum is important. I'm comfortable approving a commercial exception on the following terms:

- Adjusted committed price: 17% discount on the published 12mo commit price (applies for the first 12 months).
- One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 applied within first invoice cycle.
- Throughput SLA addendum: 95th pct latency target of <=300ms for 32-token responses with a defined remediation credit (1% monthly credit per 0.5% SLA miss, up to 10%).
- Legal to confirm standard indemnities and that we keep published discount banding for benchmarking.

Marissa — please prepare the commercial redline and DocuSign packet. Ben — inform procurement and ask for a small validation window (1 week) on our dedicated cluster to confirm throughput.

I'll loop Evelyn for visibility but this exception is approved from Sales leadership.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
